kling_entries.title: Kling 4.0 Keyframe To Video
kling_entries.pricingDesc:
720P: 28.5 credits/s ($0.1425), 1080P: 42.5 credits/s ($0.2125), 4K: 99 credits/s ($0.495) — billed on the output duration (3–30 s).
HDR (1080P / 4K only): +8.5 credits/s ($0.0425) at 1080P, +14 credits/s ($0.07) at 4K.

High-tier top-ups include +10% bonus credits. Effective pricing is approximately 10% lower than the above rates.

kling_entries.title: Kling 4.0 Reference To Video
kling_entries.pricingDesc:
720P: 17 credits/s ($0.085/s, with video) | 28.5 credits/s ($0.1425/s, no video)
1080P: 25.5 credits/s ($0.1275/s, with video) | 42.5 credits/s ($0.2125/s, no video)
4K: 59 credits/s ($0.295/s, with video) | 99 credits/s ($0.495/s, no video)
HDR (1080P / 4K only): +8.5 credits/s ($0.0425/s) at 1080P | +14 credits/s ($0.07/s) at 4K

🔸Note🔸: Video input has a lower per-second rate because the input duration is billed as well.

- No video input (text, images, image subjects or voices only): rate × output duration
- With video input: rate × (output × 2) when total input duration ≤ output duration; rate × (input + output) when input is longer. Multiple input videos are summed. Example: 10 s output + 5 s input = 20 s; with a 15 s input, 25 s.
- HDR: the HDR rate × output duration is added on top; input duration is not charged for HDR.

High-tier top-ups include +10% bonus credits. Effective pricing is approximately 10% lower than the above rates.

kling_entries.title: Kling 4.0 Flash Reference to Video
kling_entries.pricingDesc:
720P: 11.3 credits/s ($0.0565/s, with video) | 17 credits/s ($0.085/s, no video)

🔸Note🔸: Video input has a lower per-second rate because the input duration is billed as well.

- No video input (text, images or image elements only): rate × output duration
- With video input (reference videos or video elements): rate × (output × 2) when total input duration ≤ output duration; rate × (input + output) when input is longer. Multiple input videos are summed. Example: 10 s output + 5 s input = 20 s; with a 15 s input, 25 s.

High-tier top-ups include +10% bonus credits. Effective pricing is approximately 10% lower than the above rates.
